business_problem: Teleperformance was running six separate IT ticketing platforms worldwide, which made multilingual service delivery, automation, and orchestration across its internal service desk difficult.
solution_summary: Teleperformance was running six separate IT ticketing platforms worldwide, which made multilingual service delivery, automation, and orchestration across its internal service desk difficult. Teleperformance implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, IT Service Management, Virtual Agent, and Employee Center. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; IT Service Management standardizes incidents and requests; Virtual Agent handles conversational self-service; Employee Center provides a single employee portal. Requests enter through Virtual Agent and Employee Center, are classified or summarized by Now Assist before ServiceNow AI Platform and IT Service Management routes or fulfills the work. The same record of work is then exposed back to agents and end users through the platform. Running employee support and operational workflows on one data model reduced manual handoffs and made expansion easier.

solution_components.name: IT Service Management
solution_components.role: Standardizes incident, request, and fulfillment workflows on the platform.

solution_components.name: Virtual Agent
solution_components.role: Handles conversational self-service and ticket deflection for users.
